Create a full-body street-fashion photograph of a clearly adult 23-year-old Japanese woman in a rain-damp Tokyo side street at night. Use a low three-quarter full-body angle that keeps both her reference likeness and the natural inner-thigh negative-space geometry immediately recognizable.

obligation.composition_instruction: Preserve the requested adult fictional identity, role, and styling. Make the character the dominant first-look subject. In one still, connect one identifiable adult affection target or repeated marker of that same target to genuine tenderness, one concrete possessive or threatening action that crosses a personal boundary or appropriates access, and one already-visible consequence that changes that same target's access or choices. Make three outward channels coexist directly on the character: an affiliative face signal; target-locked eye-head-body attention; and one coherent primary face mode. Choose exactly one of these modes: sweet-threat mismatch (a small closed-lip asymmetric tender smile against overfocused tense eyes, with a nearly upright head; keep the same target's reaching or withdrawing movement visible and freeze one mouth corner partway through a fractional deepening while the eyes remain fixed and unchanged), dead-eye devotion (precise target lock, dim physically coherent catchlights, flattened low-contrast irises, and a tender mouth), ecstatic face cradle (both palms support the cheeks and jaw beneath flushed same-target adoration), manic possessiveness (wide sclera and tiny pupils used only as a danger amplifier), or abandonment fracture (moist eyes and a tightening mouth track the same withdrawing beloved). Treat pupil size, iris scale, catchlight state, iris contrast, gaze focus, eyelid tension, brow motion, head angle, and mouth change as independent controls. Preserve meso-scale lid tension, brow stillness, head verticality, and mouth asymmetry together; changing iris texture alone is insufficient. For a low-contrast or dead-eye mode, preserve one tiny dim scene-coherent catchlight per eye rather than beauty-style sparkle. A vacant unfocused gaze is not target lock, and a photorealistic eye must retain catchlights coherent with scene lighting. Direct camera gaze is appropriate when the camera is the beloved's point of view. Non-graphic blood, a visible weapon, a syringe, red clinical light, or a heart motif may amplify the requested intensity and must not be automatically suppressed, but no facial cue, pose, prop, or styling cue may substitute for obsessive love toward the same target. Permit fictional threat without graphic wounds, gore, dismemberment, active injection or penetration, self-harm, sexualized vulnerability, real-person stalking, or instructional wrongdoing.
